Prerequisites: Purification blitz technique

Channel your purification magics to instead dispel magical effects on those you touch. By spending 1 ki point as a standard action, make a touch attack against a creature within reach. If successful, you may attempt to dispel (via a dispel check) a number of that creature's ongoing spells and effects equal to the number of negative status effects removed with the Purification blitz technique. Use your monk level as your caster level when attempting this check.
